enhanced (
#e Passively grants 10 Ammo Capacity.
)

Taking damage while Guarding emits a blast in a wide, 8? meter long wide cone in front of you.

The blast disorients enemies hit by it for 5 seconds and deals weapon-matching elemental damage.

The damage scales up from <pve 75 /> <pvp [14] /> damage at point-blank range to the maximum of <pve 110 /> <pvp [45] /> damage after ? meters.

The strength of the disorientation against Players similarly also scales up with distance.

2.25 second cooldown between activations.
